label: Bible Study
prompt: Be _____ for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
verse: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
note: 'Careful' is KJV for 'anxious' — trade the worry for prayer with thanksgiving.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD is my _____, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
verse: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
note: Jerusalem lay in ruins, yet the poet counts the LORD as his portion — and finds that enough to hope on.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive _____ pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
verse: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
note: The peace symbol says olive branch, but Noah's dove actually brought back an olive leaf, freshly 'pluckt off.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their _____ parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verse: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.
note: The new covenant: God's law moves from stone tablets to hearts — Hebrews 8 quotes the whole passage.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a _____ cord is not quickly broken.
verse: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
note: 'A threefold cord' — a wedding-sermon favorite, usually unpacked as husband, wife, and God.
